lead_fa: Discipline Priest با آسیب‌زدن شفا می‌دهد: [[Atonement]] شفای آسیب تو را به هیل روی اهداف تبدیل می‌کند و بازی حولِ «رَمپ‌گرفتن» قبل از دمیج‌های بزرگ می‌چرخد. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Voidweaver]] که با [[Mind Blast]] شکاف ([[Voidweaver Rift]]) می‌سازد و در Midnight برای ریید و Mythic+ قوی‌تر است، و [[Oracle]] با دو شارژ [[Penance]] و Twinsight برای شفای مطمئن‌تر.

strengths: Excellent burst healing to counter heavy raid damage
Heals by dealing damage, adding a strong passive damage contribution to the raid
Powerful single-target absorbs for tank and priority-target healing
Heavy raid-wide damage reduction cooldowns: Power Word: Barrier and Pain Suppression
weaknesses: Requires being in range of an enemy to attack for Atonement healing
Ramping commits a large amount of mana; poor timings or overlapping cooldowns are punishing

nerfs: Apex Talent: Master the Darkness (Rank 3): Void Shield's chance to trigger from Penance reduced to 15% (was 33%) and Void Shield absorption reduced by 28%
buffs: New Talent: Grim Deliverance: Shadow Mend heals for 30% more and applies Atonement for an additional 4 seconds
Flash Heal is upgraded to Shadow Mend through a passive upgrade
Apex Talent: Master the Darkness can now accumulate up to 2 charges

hero.recommendation: Voidweaver is the stronger overall hero talent for both raiding and Mythic+ in Midnight Season 2: Smite becomes Void Blast for burst damage and Mind Blast becomes a powerful healing cooldown through the rift damage and the Atonement it drives. Oracle is the alternative: two charges of Penance with Twinsight adding extra bolts, stronger shields and longer Atonement durations, playing the safer route.
hero.voidweaver: Smite transforms into Void Blast for additional damage and burst; Mind Blast creates a rift dealing considerable damage with subsequent Atonement healing, and Void Shield supports the kit.
hero.oracle: Twinsight adds additional Penance bolts that heal or damage depending on usage, paired with stronger shields and longer Atonement durations.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead's talent page states Voidweaver is stronger overall for raid and Mythic+ in Midnight Season 2; the overview highlights Oracle's two-charge Penance as the safer raiding profile.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Discipline Priest Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/priest/discipline/talent-builds-pve-healer), export strings captured verbatim from each build row's /talent-calc/blizzard/ link on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Always be casting: maintain Shadow Word: Pain and fill with Penance, Mind Blast and Smite to drive Atonement.
Discipline is a ramping healer: prepare for known damage events by building Atonement coverage in advance.
Mythic+ healing is cooldown-driven: smart Evangelism, Archangel, Pain Suppression and Ultimate Penitence usage decides the dungeon.
Always be casting: keep Shadow Word: Pain up and spend downtime on Penance, Mind Blast and Smite.
Ramp before damage events by building Atonement count.
Cooldowns like Evangelism or the Voidweaver Rift are the backbone of Mythic+ healing.
st_priority: Maintain Shadow Word: Pain on enemies if less than 20 seconds remain
Use Penance offensively and never overcap charges
Cast Void Blast as much as possible
Cast Void Shield any time it is available
Use Power Word: Shield frequently when mana is good and Weal and Woe stacks are high (around 6 or more)
Use Surge of Light Flash Heals to cheaply apply Atonement
Cast Power Word: Radiance on cooldown for mini-ramps and hold 2 charges for major cooldowns
Cast Shadow Word: Death in execute (below 20%)
rotation.aoe_note: Group healing runs through Power Word: Radiance ramps into Evangelism or the Voidweaver Rift: hold two Radiance charges for major damage windows and spend the ramp on the group before the event hits.

cooldowns.Ultimate Penitence: Use separately from Evangelism, with a spell-queued Void Shield to maximize output.
cooldowns.Evangelism: Use for major healing periods; it grants instant Power Word: Radiance casts and shortens the ramp from about 15 seconds to about 8.
cooldowns.Archangel: Use for the flat heal and absorption increase when other cooldowns are spent.
cooldowns.Pain Suppression: Damage reduction for a target when other cooldowns are spent.
cooldowns.Power Word: Barrier: Raid-wide heavy damage reduction; align with the biggest raid damage events.

rotation.hero_notes: With Evangelism the ramp profile is quicker: it casts Power Word: Radiance and makes the next two casts instant, cutting setup time from about 15 seconds to about 8.

gearing_rules: The weapon slot contains a lot of power: spend Venomstones there first, ideally upgrading your Ula'tek dagger.
After the weapon, upgrade trinkets next since they carry a lot of primary stat.
Neck comes after weapon and trinkets.

stats.cheatsheet: Intellect >> Haste > Mastery > Critical Strike > Versatility; the order is similar for Oracle and Voidweaver in raids and dungeons. In raids Haste means more Atonements applied and extended; in dungeons prioritize damage; Versatility is excellent for M+ survivability; after Haste the secondaries are close, so chase item level.
notes: Haste allows more Atonements to be applied and extended in raids.
Dungeon stat focus is maximizing damage while keeping throughput.
Rings: higher Haste pieces are fine if the item level gap is not too large.
stats.per_hero_or_mode: Raid: Oracle Intellect > Haste > Mastery > Critical Strike > Versatility; Voidweaver Haste > Intellect > Mastery > Critical Strike > Versatility. Dungeons: both heroes Intellect > Haste > Mastery > Critical Strike > Versatility.

mplus.hero_note: Voidweaver is the stronger overall hero for Mythic+ in Midnight Season 2; Oracle with its two-charge Penance remains a safe, stable alternative.
tips: Discipline is at its strongest with cooldowns: Evangelism ramps and the Voidweaver Rift carry dungeon healing windows.
You must be in range of an enemy to attack for Atonement healing: plan positioning around pulls.
Ramping commits a lot of mana: avoid overlapping cooldowns and wasted ramps.
Power Word: Barrier and Pain Suppression are strong defensive cooldowns for dangerous pulls.
Mobility is very poor: pre-position before mechanics rather than reacting.
